crypto_headlines.title: DTCC launches its tokenization service
crypto_headlines.summary: DTCC's Tokenization Service is live with 34 securities at launch, including selected large-cap Russell 1000 stocks, ETFs and US Treasuries, initially on Canton Network and Besu.

crypto_headlines.title: BTC ETFs add $176M while ETH ETFs see outflows
crypto_headlines.summary: Per SoSoValue, US spot Bitcoin ETFs took in a net $176M on Oct. 27, led by BlackRock's IBIT at $151M, while spot Ethereum ETFs saw a net $60.22M leave.

crypto_headlines.title: Bitcoin heads for a second straight red October
crypto_headlines.summary: Per CryptoQuant, Bitcoin is down 4.2% for the month so far. The Fed's FOMC decision lands today, with Chair Warsh's press conference at 2:30 p.m. ET.

crypto_headlines.title: Moody's rates Ripple's RLUSD stablecoin
crypto_headlines.summary: Moody's assigned RLUSD A2 long-term and P-1 short-term ratings, citing reserves held mostly in US Treasurys and cash.

crypto_headlines.title: Itaú becomes first bank registered for crypto under Brazil's new rules
crypto_headlines.summary: Brazil's largest private bank formally registered crypto trading and custody with the central bank two days before the Oct. 30 deadline, offering 15 crypto assets including BTC, ETH and SOL.

crypto_headlines.title: Thailand's Supreme Court recognizes Bitcoin as property
crypto_headlines.summary: Watcher.Guru reports Thailand's Supreme Court officially recognized Bitcoin as legal property.

doginal_news.title: Pyth Indices and the Longer Trading Day
doginal_news.summary: Pyth's new article says the Terminal catalog lists 75 stable Pyth Index feeds and 23 coming soon as of Oct. 27, up from 17 products at the June launch, with Kalshi, Coinbase, Kraken, OKX and Lighter using them.

doginal_news.title: PIRB on Pyth prices through weekend turbulence
doginal_news.summary: PIRB highlighted how Pyth kept delivering prices for EWZ through last weekend's market turbulence.

doginal_news.title: Surprise packages reach the community
doginal_news.summary: Twin shared a surprise package from Bark, GodsBurnt, Shield and Doginal Dogs, and @doginaldogs and @DDLTCG both reposted it.

doginal_news.title: Sneak peek at the next Masterset page
doginal_news.summary: homeMetaX shared work-in-progress looks at the next DDLTCG Masterset page, and @DDLTCG reposted it.

doginal_news.title: Grading tip: check card backs
doginal_news.summary: And sent seven DDLTCG cards to AGS grading and says visible print lines on the backs cost him two near misses, so check the back before you submit.

notes: No official @doginaldogs statement yet on the marketplace listing exploit; its account posted community reposts only in the last 24 hours.
